Estimate Momentum measures change in analyst sentiment over time and may be an indicator of future price movements. The Change in Consensus chart shows the current, 1 week ago, and 1 month ago consensus earnings per share (EPS*) forecasts.
 For the fiscal quarter endingSep 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has decreased over the past week from 14.04 to 14.01(0.21%) and decreased over the past month from 14.24 to 14.01(1.62%). Of the 4 analysts making quarterly forecasts, none raised and 0 lowered their forecast.
 For the fiscal year ending Dec 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has decreased over the past week from 55.73 to 55.69(14.04) and decreased over the past month from 55.86 to 55.73(0.23%). Of the 5 analysts making yearly forecasts, 1raised and 4 lowered their forecast.
